Quirk Control.name: Quirk Control
Quirk Control.description: Covers: precise, safe and partial use of the character's own Quirk: fine targeting, holding back, shaping, utility and nonlethal use. Easy: a practiced everyday use. Hard: precise use in chaos or near civilians. Exceptional: a fine feat at the edge of the Quirk's scale. Not: raw force or damage, which is Quirk Output. Primary attribute: Technique.
